ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate approximately 92% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized in linear and point-source distributions comprising approximately 8% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous mass across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white linear clusters are mapped to the upper distal quadrants of both lobes. Fine-grain high-intensity point-clusters (0-15 pixels) are scattered across the lower medial surface near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth of depression is roughly 22% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration. Left lobe features three primary peaks with irregular valleys; right lobe shows a more fragmented, step-like topography with a significant indentation approximately 15% inward from the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the superior margins, curving outward toward the tips; distal ends exhibit a downward-curving concavity at the extreme points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (likely barnacle attachment scars) detected in the mid-left lobe and clustered along the lower central region of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); specifically, a group of four parallel lines on the upper left lobe and three distinct vertical parallel lines on the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring patterns including multi-linear rake marks across both lobe surfaces and significant irregular tissue loss/jaggedness along the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique triplet of parallel vertical white bars located on the extreme right lobe tip, contrasting sharply against the dark background.
